kind: analyze (Ba-Ba strain maps of a dislocation-dipole cell; region and core identification; region contrast, extremes, threshold counts)
provenance: Existing L4 strain analysis (3_reproduction/L4/result.json, graded M1-M7 and region_means_pct), recomputed by repository-only reviewer/make_reference_submission.py using actual Ba-gap endpoint midpoints. Near-core masks are compared in 5_review/self_review_all_20260912/implementation/analysis/geometry_audit.json; the selected extrema and all strain statistics are unchanged. Tolerances remain result.json key tolerances. No new simulation.

core_BaO_xy_A.rule: each coordinate within 4.0 A absolute (one lattice spacing; identification band, handbook 2(5) exception: the position is defined by the prompt's rule)

contrast_xx_pct.rule: +/-10 percent relative (scalar rule 2(1)); sign is part of the value. The region means themselves are not graded: their absolute values depend on the reference spacings and region B's sign is a recorded fidelity miss (L4 guard G2a) The additive reference baseline cancels in the difference, but the contrast still scales as 1/d0: 100*(mean(d_A)-mean(d_B))/d0.

contrast_yy_pct.rule: +/-10 percent relative; sign is part of the value

n_eps_xx_above_10pct.rule: exact integer (rule 2(4)). Nearest sites to the 10.0 threshold: 9.720 and 10.595 percent

n_eps_yy_below_minus3p5pct.rule: exact integer (rule 2(4)). Nearest sites to the -3.5 threshold: -3.556 and -3.334 percent; the value is deterministic for the stated protocol and reference on the staged file

not_graded.region_means: eps_xx_mean_A/B_pct, eps_yy_mean_A/B_pct enter only through the two contrasts
not_graded.eps_zz: Not requested or evaluated. A single periodic Ba plane fixes spatially uniform z spacing; strain against an independent reference need not be zero.

score: 1 only if every primary check passes (binary all-primary-pass)

reference_builder.scope: Repository-only provenance tool; not executable from a standalone review kit. grader.py and selfcheck.py do not import it.
dependencies: staged inputs and reproduction result records
reference_builder.core_definition: Periodic Cartesian midpoint of actual Ba gap endpoints in the outermost region-A row; output in original data-file coordinates. Dependent geometry recomputed.
